_comment: Editable skeleton for save-dir discovery. Key = RomM platform fs_slug
from config.json/tested server. Value = list of local directories (paths
relative to the app's script dir resident release the app runs next to
RETROBAT_ROOT). Adjust per your RetroBAT install; the Phase-1 read-only
audit prints what each map actually finds so you can fix it without
guessing. Save files (.srm/.sav/...) vs savestates (.state/slot files)
are matched by extension in scanner.py.
Scanning walks each entry recursively. A '* ' wildcard key is a fallback
glob for any platform_fs_slug not listed.
